## Why it happens

MQTT over TLS needs a certificate and key in `MQTT_SSL_PEM_CERT` and `MQTT_SSL_PEM_KEY` (and `MQTT_SSL_PEM_CA` for client certificates). When either file is missing or unreadable, port 8883 stays closed.

## Fix it

Set both variables to readable PEM files and restart the server.

## Check that it worked

`nc -vz <server> 8883` succeeds.
